paragraphs: Shadowtrack Technologies sells a corrections technology platform that combines institutional operations and community supervision on one connected record. Its pages say that corrections agencies, jails and prisons, sheriffs' offices, probation and parole departments, pretrial programs, courts, and attorneys use it for smartphone monitoring, wrist-worn and ankle-worn devices, case management, and officer safety.

The case management platform is presented as one connected record per justice participant, running from intake, classification, housing, and custody decisions through release and community supervision. The institutional operations suite is described as facility management software for jails and prisons that replaces paper movement passes with a Digital Master Pass, manages housing and bed assignments, and tracks transports in real time.

On the community side, the platform is described as letting courts, agencies, and supervising offices monitor enrollees on a smartphone app, a non-smartphone, or a landline. Shadowtrack SecureCheck is presented as direct enrollment for house arrest and electronic monitoring, with location and identity verification on a standard smartphone.

quote.text: One connected record for every Justice Participant, across institutional operations and community supervision, from intake to reentry.
